steps.text: We are here today to commemorate the past, and to welcome a new beginning.
All who stand with me today are my brothers and sisters. Fate has brought us together, and every bond that we formed is a gift given to us by the monastery.
We will not forget the bread and the beer, nor the bells and the fields. We will not forget the Law that we studied, nor the love that we shared.
We meet here today to bid farewell to Landen Monastery.

steps.name: Hildegard
steps.text: Is there no other way?

steps.name: Pious Cleric
steps.text: I understand your feelings, but the church has decided to close the monastery down at the end of the year.

steps.name: Pious Cleric
steps.text: It can no longer support itself, and the church will no longer fund its operations.

steps.name: Pious Cleric
steps.text: All we can do is bid it a respectful and dignified farewell.

steps.name: Hildegard
steps.text: Can we not have a little more time? Everyone is doing their utmost to find a way to save the monastery.

steps.name: Hildegard
steps.text: Maybe we'll find a way to improve our finances...

steps.name: Pious Cleric
steps.text: I'm afraid the church has already given us more than enough time.

steps.name: Hildegard
steps.text: But why does it have to be demolished?

steps.name: Hildegard
steps.text: If we could at least keep the building...

steps.name: Pious Cleric
steps.text: The monastery's land will have to be sold to repay its debts.

steps.name: Pious Cleric
steps.text: While we'll always have fond memories of its fields and its sunshine, we should not prevent the land from realizing its value.

steps.name: Hildegard
steps.text: Maybe I could have prevented this if only I'd worked harder...

steps.name: Pious Cleric
steps.text: I regret this as much as you do, sister, but as the teachings say, we must learn to accept what we cannot change.

steps.name: Pious Cleric
steps.text: May the beauty of days past live forever in our memories, and bless the future of our brothers and sisters—

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Now leave the demolition to me!

steps.name: Hildegard
steps.text: Exusiai?!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Obviously abandoned buildings should be disposed of, pronto.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: So if this monastery isn't doing its job anymore, there's only one thing left to do—blow it up spectacularly!

steps.name: Hildegard
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Hildegard
steps.text: Wait a second! Even if it must be demolished, it should be done respectfully, not like this—

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Coming through, coming through!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: No time to talk! Let's send this centuries-old antique out with a bang!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Three, two—

steps.name: Hildegard
steps.text: Wait––

steps.name: Hildegard
steps.text: Wait!

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: Wait!

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: Oh, thank goodness, it was just a dream...

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: Oh right! There was a meet-and-greet session today... did I fall asleep on the job?!

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: Don't worry, no one showed up in the half hour that you were dozing off.

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: I see, that's a relief...

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: No it's not!

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: We've been here since early morning, and we haven't sold a single album!

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: There are long lines in front of every other artist's booth, too. This is pretty awful, even considering your current popularity... or lack thereof.

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: I'm sorry, I should have worked harder.

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: Oh, I'm not saying you're lazy. I know how much effort you've put in.

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: But it takes more than hard work to be an idol! You need relevancy and instant appeal!

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: It's my fault too, for approving that nun gimmick of yours. Next time, we really ought to be more conscious of local appeal.

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: Gimmick? I was only being myself...

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: (And what purpose is there in being an idol, if I can't promote the monastery?)

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: To be blunt, your career is at a crossroads.

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: Today's meet-and-greet and album signing session is our last chance. If we can't sell these leftover albums, we might as well pack our bags.

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: I'm not sure what I can do at this point, but I'll give it my all!

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: Look, someone's coming over!

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: Get ready! This might be our first customer of the day!

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: Ahem...

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: (Recites without a hitch)

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: 'The bells sing a song of love. We meet today, as ordained by beautiful fate.'

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: Welcome, and let us listen to the sounds of love and hope together!

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: Buy a copy of 'Sonata of Love's Bells' today, and get a free box of Landen Monastery's famous cystymilk bread!

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: (Makes a pose that is energetic but dignified)

steps.name: Excited Fan
steps.text: Y-You're the famous—!

steps.name: Excited Fan
steps.text: Oh, I'm so lucky! I never thought I'd see you here!

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: Thank you for the support. I wouldn't exactly call myself 'famous' though...

steps.name: Excited Fan
steps.text: I hear you over the radio all the time, and I've bought a lot of your albums.

steps.name: Excited Fan
steps.text: This is the first time I've seen you in person, but you're just as brilliant as I imagined you'd be!

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: (Is this what it's like to be popular? Deep breaths, deep breaths, look like an idol!)

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: (Sunny and elegant smile)

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: Thank you very much. Please continue to support my songs.

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: 'Those who know to appreciate others are blessed with wisdom and kindness.' May good fortune be upon you.

steps.name: Excited Fan
steps.text: Your voice is so sweet! Just like the way you sing!

steps.name: Excited Fan
steps.text: I'm so excited I got to meet you today!

steps.name: Excited Fan
steps.text: So can I get your autograph, Sora?

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: Of course! Everyone here for the meet-and-greet will—

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: ...Sora?

steps.name: Confused Fan
steps.text: ...Sora?

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: You got the wrong person.

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: The sign says 'Archetto,' not 'Sora.'

steps.name: Perplexed Fan
steps.text: Archetto? Who's Archetto?

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: Anyone else would've been furious at getting mistaken for another idol at their own meet-and-greet...

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: But you even gave him bread?

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: 'Do not resent a misunderstanding,' 'Do not be carried away by fame that does not belong to you,'...That's what the teachings say.

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: There's no reason to get angry at that gentleman over a simple mistake.

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: Well, that's nice, but has it ever occurred to you that this is why you don't have any fans?

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: I thought it was because my singing and dancing weren't good enough.

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: No, what you're lacking most is the ability to promote your character.

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: Your gimmick is a nun, but you can't just 'be a nun' in front of the fans.

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: You need to identify what fans love about the image of a nun, and refine, polish, and deliver on that.

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: But I only know how to be a cleric, not how to be an idol.

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: I understand that I'm promoting a business, but it always feels like I'm hiding my face behind that of another.

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: The most important thing for a professional idol is to generate interest with your image and bring in revenue. That's what the advertisers are investing in, at least.

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: Failing to maintain a consistent and appealing image will only hurt the sponsors.

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: Have I... ever done anything to hurt the sponsors?

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: Advertising your monastery's cystymilk bread in a dessert parlor ad, bringing up beer on talk shows, getting caught on video catching a thief on the streets...

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: Don't tell me you forgot all that?

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: While I understand now that a young idol shouldn't be talking about drinking... how exactly is catching a thief a bad thing?

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: The facts notwithstanding, all the public saw was an idol getting into a street fight.

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: And clarifying what happened isn't cheap either.

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: Not to mention how the children's clothing brand was NOT happy with their brand ambassador getting into a fight, regardless of why.

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: They never mentioned that in the contract...

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: No, I apologize, it was my fault.

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: I had high hopes for you, you know... I've always been confident in my eye for talent.

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: Money aside, I was looking forward to seeing 'Archetto' shining brightly on stage.

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: I'm sorry... I wish I could have done more.

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: Never mind that. Keep doing what you need to here. I'll ask around the other booths and see if we can get some tips.

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: What it means to be a professional idol...

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: Excuse me!

steps.name: Hildegard
steps.text: Er... yes?

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: You seem to carry yourself well. Have you ever thought about becoming an idol?

steps.name: Hildegard
steps.text: Er... an idol? What does that mean?

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: You don't even know what an idol is?!

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: Well... in short, it's about singing and dancing, becoming famous, and bringing hope and joy to people!

steps.name: Hildegard
steps.text: (Singing? Dancing? I do regularly sing hymns, but I've never danced...)

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: Just imagine! Standing on the big stage in beautiful costumes, thousands of eyes focused solely on you. The feeling of accomplishment—

steps.name: Hildegard
steps.text: (Becoming famous? Could this be a chance to promote the monastery?)

steps.name: Hildegard
steps.text: Would becoming an idol let me use my fame to advertise products?

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: (Wow, this girl really gets it!)

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: Of course! You're absolutely free to, once you're on the right track.

steps.name: Hildegard
steps.text: Well, you've piqued my interest. Could you elaborate?

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: Excellent! No time to waste. Let's find a place to sit down and go over the contract!

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: I thought I'd found an opportunity to promote the monastery, but I can't even fulfill the basic terms of the contract.

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: The teachings were right. 'Paths that look too smooth often lead you astray.'

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: Promoting the monastery isn't easy at all...

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: Oh, someone's coming.

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: 'The bells of love welcome you, visitor from afar—'

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: Er... May I help you?

steps.name: Old Lady
steps.text: Excuse me, I saw the sign next to the bread that says 'free giveaway'... So you're handing it out for free?

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: Er, yes, as part of the meet-and-greet...

steps.name: Old Lady
steps.text: So I can get bread just for shaking hands with you?

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: Er...

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: (It's supposed to be for buying the albums, isn't it?)

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: (But this old woman looks...)

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: ...It's alright. Go ahead and take one.

steps.name: Old Lady
steps.text: Are you sure?

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: Of course! I'm just glad to be of help.

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: 'May your honesty and kindness be repaid with peace and happiness in equal measure.'

steps.name: Old Lady
steps.text: I haven't had anything this good in a month...

steps.name: Old Lady
steps.text: Thank you so much. You're very kind.
The old lady grasps Archetto's hand firmly, as though to communicate her gratitude.
The touch of her rough skin is warm and sincere.

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: Thank you for your support. Have a beautiful day.

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: My first, er, fan?

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: Well, that takes us from zero to one. Keep at it; it's our last chance to revitalize the monastery!

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: H-Hello...

steps.name: Innocent Girl
steps.text: Hello! Can I have some bread?

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: Bread...?

steps.name: Innocent Girl
steps.text: Someone told me I could get free bread here!

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: Well... not exactly...

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: (But I can't make a child this small pay for it, can I?)

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: ...Here you go. If you like it, tell your friends, too!

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: And thank you for the support. 'May the gospels watch over you, and grant you wisdom and health.'

steps.name: Innocent Girl
steps.text: Thank you! Your voice is so sweet, and you're so pretty, just like those idols on TV!

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: 'Just like those idols,' eh? Should I take that as a compliment?

steps.name: Impoverished Young Man
steps.text: (Approaches quietly)

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: H-Hello!

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: 'The voice of love is always here for you...' Would you like an autographed album?

steps.name: Impoverished Young Man
steps.text: (Scratches head in embarrassment)

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: (This gentleman doesn't look like he has a lot of money to spare...)

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: Ahem... thank you for the support. Please, have some bread.

steps.name: Impoverished Young Man
steps.text: (Takes the bread eagerly)

steps.name: Impoverished Young Man
steps.text: (Leaves in satisfaction)

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: Thank you... have a beautiful day...

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: Should I move the sign advertising the album to a more prominent position?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: I'm back!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: They were handing out cystymilk bread in the old district!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Are you serious?! Next you'll be telling me there's only one moon in the sky!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: It looked like charity work by the Lateran church? There were lots of people standing in line, almost like one of my concerts.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: The nun handing it out was really nice and pretty, and the bread tastes great too. Much better than those dessert parlors you see everywhere.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Wow, you're right, it reminds me of home.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Does the Lateran church often do things like this?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Maybe, but they seem more likely to hand out dessert coupons.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Say, I think I've seen the girl handing them out somewhere before... but where?

steps.name: Tabloid Reporter
steps.text: Alright, I'm on scene, chief.

steps.name: Tabloid Reporter
steps.text: Sheesh, what's the point of reporting on meet-and-greets by no-name idols? Any article I get out of this won't even pay for the taxi fare.

steps.name: Tabloid Reporter
steps.text: Guess I'll just take a couple of photos and—hey, what's with that crowd?

steps.name: Tabloid Reporter
steps.text: And at the head of the line is... the girl I caught on film beating someone up on the streets the other day?!

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Well now, you don't see crowds like this in the slums every day.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: I wonder if Tung would get as many people lined up if he handed out free finballs.

steps.name: Eurill
steps.text: Never underestimate what a good promotional image can do for you. Not that I ever expected her to make it this big when I chose to work with her.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: You've always had an eye for business partners. I suppose not all Laterans are like those crazy girls working for the penguin.

steps.name: Eurill
steps.text: I've always placed high value on cultural exchange in business.

steps.name: Eurill
steps.text: Of course, it's debatable whether taking a pure loss like she is counts as 'business.'

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: A bit of foreign culture in your life is never a bad thing.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Maybe you could talk to Wei, see if he'd approve the construction of a Lateran chapel in the slums?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Give those old folks a place to sit during the day, at any rate. All the better if there's more free bread.

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: Archetto... what's with this line?! You didn't use Arts, did you?!

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: I'm not sure. I was acting as I always do... as a cleric.

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: Wait, but why haven't you sold any albums yet?

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: Oh, never mind that for now... come on, say your catchphrases while everyone's listening!

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: 'We gather here today, brothers and sisters all.'

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: 'We will all love each other, help each other...'

steps.name: Archetto
steps.text: ...Like that?

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: That just makes it even weirder!
A long line forms in front of an unremarkable booth in a corner of this great city.
The setting sun paints the people's heads golden as a Liberi girl continues to give out bread to the people in line, to the tune of hymns arranged with drumbeat loops.
A peaceful scene, reminiscent of a mural in a cathedral.

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: Are you sure you don't want to renew your contract?

steps.name: Hildegard
steps.text: Yes, I have no regrets.

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: Even though we didn't sell any albums last time, there's no question that it went viral on the web.

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: 'What a public personality should be like,' 'A true nun idol'... that's what they're calling you!

spans.text: be like,' 'A true nun idol'... that's what they're calling you!

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: You'll have access to so many more resources now if you stay.

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: I'm sure you'd be shining on the big stage before long. Just like Sora!

steps.name: Hildegard
steps.text: No... I've decided to step away.

steps.name: Hildegard
steps.text: I've fulfilled my contract and promoted the monastery in Lungmen. It's time to look for other business partners.

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: Well, I guess it's back to square one... What a shame; I thought I'd finally found someone who was going to make it big.

steps.name: Hildegard
steps.text: I apologize, and thank you for everything you've done for me. But I have other things that I need to do.

steps.name: Hildegard
steps.text: I've been away from Laterano for so long, but I've never forgotten my true goal: to spread the Lateran faith.

steps.name: Hildegard
steps.text: Succeeding at business was never what I really wanted.

steps.name: Hildegard
steps.text: And even if I must out of necessity, I'd rather be selling something more tangible, more concrete.

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: That's very honest of you... Well, it's a pity, but I understand. Good luck.

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: What are your plans, then?

steps.name: Hildegard
steps.text: 'Opportunity lies on the path that leads far into the distance.' We'll see.

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: Well... before you leave, there's a concert being organized by Monster Siren Records, and the sponsor, MountainDash Logistics, has sent you a personal invitation.

steps.name: Manager
steps.text: Even if you have to go, would you at least consider making a farewell appearance?

steps.name: Hildegard
steps.text: Did you say Monster Siren Records? And MountainDash Logistics?!

steps.name: Cheerful Cleric
steps.text: What's that you're looking at?

steps.name: Solemn Cleric
steps.text: There was something else mixed in with the taped movies Fiammetta brought back.

steps.name: Cheerful Cleric
steps.text: Is that Hildegard singing on stage?!

steps.name: Solemn Cleric
steps.text: I never thought she had it in her.

steps.name: Cheerful Cleric
steps.text: It's not so strange when you think about it. She's always had a beautiful singing voice. But this hymn has some interesting variations.

steps.name: Solemn Cleric
steps.text: What do they call the people who do this, again? Idols?

steps.name: Solemn Cleric?
steps.text: Maybe we could learn from it to help promote the monastery?

steps.name: Cheerful Cleric
steps.text: What would we perform? Musicals based on religious stories? Choral performances?

steps.name: Solemn Cleric?
steps.text: We'd need some foreign characters too, if we want to catch people's attention in Laterano.

steps.name: Solemn Cleric?
steps.text: Say... what do you think of a joint performance by Kazimierzian knights and Iberian Inquisitors?
